answer: Each epoch node seals a state root by hashing a dedicated 8GB RAM array with Blake3, then floods its unique root as a plume across peers. Verifiers sample 64 random offsets against stored roots; a forged Sybil identity cannot reproduce a prior root without replaying the exact array, and replaying 10000 ghosts costs 80TB RAM plus $41000 monthly. Any mismatch at the horizon of two epochs freezes emission, and honest nectar withheld from the faker flows to verified nodes.
